definitions.explanation: A priest who serves at a Shinto shrine, performing rituals, prayers, and ceremonies. The head priest of a shrine.

examples.japanese: {神主|かんぬし}が{祝詞|のりと}をあげた。
examples.english: The Shinto priest recited a prayer.

examples.japanese: {神社|じんじゃ}の{神主|かんぬし}にお{祓|はら}いをしてもらった。
examples.english: I had the shrine priest perform a purification ritual for me.

examples.japanese: {代々|だいだい}{神主|かんぬし}を{務|つと}める{家系|かけい}だ。
examples.english: It is a family line that has served as Shinto priests for generations.

notes:
RELATED TERMS:
- {宮司|ぐうじ}: chief priest of a shrine (formal title)
- {巫女|みこ}: shrine maiden
- {神職|しんしょく}: Shinto clergy (collective/formal term)

{神主|かんぬし} is the most common everyday term. {宮司|ぐうじ} is the formal title for the head priest of a shrine.
